run_kappa_calculations: run thermal conductivity calculations on a list of ASE atoms structures using KappaRunner
create_kappa_runner: create a KappaRunner instance with an ASE calculator and input atoms data for kappa calculations
read_extxyz_structures: read atomic structures from an extxyz file using get_kappa103_data_list for kappa analysis
write_kappa_results: write kappa calculation results to a compressed JSON file using KappaRunner write_results method
review_kappa_pipeline: review the KappaRunner calculate method that relaxes structures and computes thermal conductivity
